newsitem.title: USA: America Online books $27 mln in ad revenues.
newsitem.headline: America Online books $27 mln in ad revenues.

text.p: America Online Inc said that it already has booked $27 million in advertising revenues on its online service in the past 45 days, as part of its plan to develop new revenue streams.

AOL chairman and CEO Steve Case told reporters on a conference call that AOL is building up three new revenue streams - advertising, transactions and sales of "private" versions of the AOL service to corporate and organizational users.
Case was talking to reporters to discuss the "new AOL" and to describe some new marketing strategies.
